title: Struck out in one tilde: Use ~old~ new names.
head: 25101f828917cd4547927c4aa9a0a8771d6bfeaf

clause.text: Text in one tilde or two is struck out, as on GitHub (GFM's strikethrough): "Use ~old~ new names." strikes out "old", no tilde left, as `~~old~~` does

scenes.caption: code-style's SKILL.md says "Use ~old~ new names.", then "Use ~~old~~ new names.": "old" struck out each time, no tilde left

clause.text: the closing tildes are as many as the opening ones, else it is text: `~a~~`

scenes.caption: "~a~~" and "~~a~": the closing tildes are not as many as the opening ones, so it is text

clause.text: three or more, `~~~a~~~`, a tilde with a space after the opening one or before the closing one, `~ a~`, or an escaped `\~` is text

scenes.caption: "~~~a~~~", "~ a~" and "\~a~" are text: three tildes, a space inside, an escaped tilde

clause.text: as in GFM, a tilde before punctuation opens only after a space or punctuation, and one after punctuation closes only before them

scenes.caption: "~/bin and ~/lib" is text: a tilde after punctuation, before a letter, closes nothing; "~(a)~" is struck out

clause.text: a tilde in an autolink `<…>`, a link's destination or a bare URL opens and closes nothing: in "Install to ~/bin, see [docs](https://example.edu/~jdoe/)." no text is struck out, and the link goes to `https://example.edu/~jdoe/`

scenes.caption: "Install to ~/bin, see [docs](https://example.edu/~jdoe/).": nothing struck out, the link goes to ~jdoe

clause.text: a closing tilde ends the nearest one that opens, and struck-out text may hold struck-out text: "Build takes ~2 min. Old step ~deprecated~." strikes out "deprecated" alone, `~a ~b~ c~` is "a b c" struck out, "b" twice

scenes.caption: "Build takes ~2 min. Old step ~deprecated~.": only "deprecated" is struck out; "~a ~b~ c~" is struck out, "b" twice
